title: upgrade attention kernels: flashattentionv2 + fused qkv + rotary (rope) streaming optimizations
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: Reduce per-token latency and increase throughput for common transformer serving shapes by integrating FlashAttentionV2 variants, adding a fused QKV transpose+matmul kernel, and optimizing rotary/rope position embedding for cached KV streaming. The change reduces kernel launch overhead, improves memory layout for KV cache uploads, and provides a fast fallback when device/drivers do not support the fused paths. Summary of changes: 1) Add optional FlashAttentionV2 backend with feature detection and build flag; 2) Implement fused qkv transpose + scaled matmul kernel for typical shapes to cut kernel launches; 3) Add cache-aware rotary/rope path that performs in-place rotates for streamed decode and avoids dense rotations for cached KV; 4) Update scheduler heuristics to prefer fused kernels for batch sizes <=32 and seq_len <=1024; 5) Change KV cache layout to contiguous per-GPU shards to enable single-shot multi-request uploads; 6) Add runtime capability checks and automated fallback to previous kernels on unsupported drivers; 7) Add microbenchmarks and perf-canary rollout. Backwards compatibility: API unchanged; fallback path enabled by default on unknown hardware. Testing: unit tests for rotary math, GPU matrix kernel tests, end-to-end streaming perf tests, CI GPU build matrix, 10% canary rollout before full production. Related tasks: ENG-9123, ENG-9245; references previous PRs pr-30658 and pr-25801.
